verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML and KYC compliance platform covering onboarding screening, monitoring and case management. Platforms of this kind can plausibly offer identity verification with liveness checks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions defenses against deepfakes, AI-generated faces or camera-injection attacks, or any biometric or liveness capability; the documentation covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, transactions and cases.
